company_name_at_filing: FILANA THERAPEUTICS, INC. (formerly Cassava Sciences, Inc.)
notes: Company renamed Cassava Sciences -> Filana Therapeutics; ticker now FLNA on Nasdaq. Alzheimer's Phase 3 program (simufilam) failed and was discontinued in 2025; pivoted to TSC-related epilepsy. FDA placed full clinical hold on planned TSC proof-of-concept trial on Dec 15, 2025.

claims.claim_text: Two randomized placebo-controlled Phase 3 clinical trials of oral simufilam in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's disease were conducted: RETHINK-ALZ (NCT04994483, 800 patients) and REFOCUS-ALZ (NCT05026177, 1,125 patients). Total enrollment was 1,900 patients including 1,153 treated with simufilam during blinded phase. Both trials failed pre-specified co-primary, secondary and exploratory biomarker endpoints (announced 11/25/2024 and 3/25/2025 respectively).
claims.subject: Cassava Sciences / Filana Therapeutics
claims.source_quote: The 800 patients enrolled in the first Phase 3 study, called RETHINK-ALZ, received either 100 mg simufilam tablets or placebo twice daily for 52 weeks (NCT04994483). The 1,125 patients enrolled in the second Phase 3 study, called REFOCUS-ALZ, received either 100 mg and 50 mg simufilam tablets or placebo twice daily for 76 weeks (NCT05026177).

claims.claim_text: Phase 2 24-month clinical safety study of simufilam in Alzheimer's disease (NCT04388254) enrolled over 200 patients recruited from 16 U.S. clinical sites; funded in part by NIH grant.
claims.subject: Cassava Sciences
claims.source_quote: In March 2020, we initiated a Phase 2 clinical safety study of simufilam in patients with Alzheimer's disease (NCT04388254). This study was funded in part by a research grant award from NIH. ... This study enrolled over 200 patients with Alzheimer's disease who were recruited from 16 U.S. clinical sites.

claims.claim_text: On December 15, 2025, the company received a formal FDA letter confirming that its proposed TSC-related epilepsy proof-of-concept clinical trial is on full clinical hold pending additional pre-clinical data and protocol design modifications. As of the filing date no proof-of-concept trial has been initiated.
claims.subject: Filana Therapeutics
claims.predicate: subject to FDA full clinical hold
claims.object_value: Full clinical hold imposed 12/15/2025 on TSC-related epilepsy IND
claims.source_quote: On December 15, 2025, the Company received a formal letter from FDA confirming that the proposed clinical trial is on full clinical hold subject to the Company providing FDA with additional information, including additional pre-clinical data, and modifying the protocol design.

claims.claim_text: On February 26, 2025, entered into an exclusive worldwide License Agreement with Yale University for IP relating to simufilam in TSC-related epilepsy and other indications. Terms include a nominal upfront fee, up to $4.5 million in clinical/regulatory/commercial milestones, royalties on net sales, and contingent payments tied to any priority review voucher transfer.
claims.subject: Filana Therapeutics / Yale University
claims.object_value: Up to $4.5M milestones; royalties; PRV transfer share
claims.source_quote: On February 26, 2025, we entered into a License Agreement ... with Yale University ... we paid Yale (i) a nominal upfront license fee, and agreed to pay (ii) payments upon the achievement of specified clinical, regulatory and commercial milestones, totaling up to $4.5 million ...

claims.claim_text: Drug supply agreement with Evonik Industries AG, which supplies clinical-grade quantities of simufilam.
claims.subject: Filana Therapeutics
claims.object_value: Evonik Industries AG (CDMO for simufilam clinical supply)
claims.source_quote: We have a drug supply agreement with Evonik Industries AG for simufilam. Under the agreement, Evonik supplies and is expected to continue to supply us with clinical-grade quantities of simufilam.

claims.claim_text: Owns nine issued U.S. patents covering simufilam (composition of matter, solid forms, methods of use for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases) with expiration dates ranging from 2029 to 2040, plus foreign filings in Europe, Australia, Israel, Canada, Japan, and additional diagnostic-asset applications.
claims.subject: Filana Therapeutics
claims.object_value: 9 issued US patents on simufilam, expiry 2029-2040
claims.source_quote: In the United States, our patent protection relating to simufilam, including its solid forms and methods of use for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases, consists of nine issued U.S. patents, with expiration dates ranging from 2029 to 2040.

claims.claim_text: Recorded loss contingencies of $35.25 million in 2025 for legal matters relating to the terminated simufilam and SavaDx programs (subject of lawsuits, claims, allegations and government investigations).
claims.subject: Filana Therapeutics
claims.object_value: $35.25M loss contingency in FY2025 for simufilam/SavaDx litigation
claims.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company recorded loss contingencies of $35.25 million, for certain of its legal matters described in Note 12.

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2025: cash and cash equivalents $95.5 million; accumulated deficit $496.1 million; net loss for 2025 of $91.0 million; ATM offering program established 11/12/2025 with up to $50M capacity (none drawn at year-end); company believes resources are sufficient to fund operations for at least the next 12 months.
claims.subject: Filana Therapeutics
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2025, cash and cash equivalents totaled $95.5 million. ... We have an accumulated deficit of $496.1 million at December 31, 2025. ... We believe that our current resources should be sufficient to fund our operations for at least the next 12 months.

claims.claim_text: Discontinued the SavaDx program (Alzheimer's blood-based exploratory biomarker) as of mid-2025; SavaDx accounted for less than 1% of R&D budget in all periods presented.
claims.subject: Filana Therapeutics
claims.source_quote: Our product candidate, called SavaDx, is an early-stage program focused on detecting the presence of Alzheimer's disease from a small sample of blood. For business, technical and personnel reasons, we discontinued the development of SavaDx as of mid-2025.
